desc: Retrieves profile metadata for each member of an organization or workspace. Returns the same profile fields as the member analytics dashboard, sorted by user ID, as the companion of `admin.analytics.members.activity`.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

include_deactivated_since.desc: Also return members deactivated on or after this day, as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC. Without it, only active members are returned.

team_id.desc: Workspace ID to scope the results to. With an organization-level token, omit it for organization-wide results. A workspace-level token may only pass its own workspace.

member_types.desc: Comma-separated list of member types to include. Omit to include every member type.

query.desc: Space-delimited search terms matched against member names, and against email addresses when the organization shows them. When the organization hides email addresses, or hides guest email addresses, the search does not match on email at all, so a hidden address cannot be recovered by searching for it. Only matching members are returned.

cursor.desc: Paginate through collections of data by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request's `response_metadata`. Default value fetches the first "page" of the collection.

limit.desc: Maximum number of members to return. Max allowed is 500.

total_count.desc: Total number of members that match the request, across all pages.

next_cursor.desc: More items exist, use next_cursor as the value of cursor for next call

invalid_arguments.desc: Required arguments either were not provided or contain invalid values, including an `include_deactivated_since` that is not a real day or is in the future.

not_an_admin.desc: The token's user is not an owner or admin, and does not have permission to access the analytics API.

feature_not_available.desc: The team's plan does not include analytics API access.

member_analytics_disabled.desc: Member analytics are disabled for the team.

team_not_on_org.desc: `team_id` is not a workspace the token can access: it is not part of the token's organization, or the token is workspace-level and `team_id` is another workspace.

too_many_search_results.desc: The search returned too many members. Narrow the `query`.

incomplete_analytics.desc: The full set of results could not be retrieved. Wait and try again.

admin_analytics_disabled.desc: Analytics are temporarily unavailable. Wait and try again.

rate_limited.desc: The organization has made too many calls to this method in a short amount of time. Wait and try again.
